question: I need help with setting up two different emails on my website. One for receiving order invoices and the other for general inquiries. Im specifically looking for guidance on how to set the email address for order confirmations in the Business Info section of my sites settings.
candidate_answer:
To set up two different emails on your website—one for order invoices and another for general inquiries—and specifically configure the email address for order confirmations in the Business Info section, follow these steps:

- First, create additional business email addresses for your domain, such as orders@yourdomain.com for order invoices and info@yourdomain.com for general inquiries. This requires purchasing additional business emails via your Google Workspace account linked to your Wix site [S1].
- To create these emails: Go to Business Email in your Wix account, select the relevant account, click More Actions, then Set Up User. Sign in to Google Workspace, add new users with the desired email addresses, and set passwords if needed [S2].
- After creating the emails, go to your Wix site's Business Info section in the site settings.
- In Business Info, update the email address for order confirmations by entering the newly created orders@yourdomain.com email. This ensures order confirmation emails are sent to the correct inbox.
- Note that it may take up to 24 hours for Google Workspace services to activate for new users [S2].

This process allows you to manage incoming emails efficiently by directing order confirmations and general inquiries to separate addresses [S1].

If you need detailed navigation within Wix settings beyond this, please specify.

To set the email address for order confirmations in the Business Info section of your site's settings, follow these steps: 

1. Go to the Business Info section of your site's settings. 
2. Scroll down to the Location & Contact Info section. 
3. Enter an email address in the Email field. 

For setting up additional business emails for different purposes, such as general inquiries, you can manage your incoming emails by setting up additional business email addresses for different parts of your company. If you own a company called Clothes by Wix, for example, and have the domain name clothesbywix.com, you can create more business emails for the different departments: info@clothesbywix.com, contact@clothesbywix.com, orders@clothesbywix.com, etc. To set up additional business emails, go to Business Email in your account, click Show User Info on the relevant account, click the More Actions icon next to the account you want to set up, select Set Up User, sign in to your Google Workspace account, enter your email address, click Next, enter your password, click Users, click Add new user, enter the user details and set a password (optional), and click Add.
